PluginData.Author: SentorX
PluginData.Tooltip: Shared Sens Essentials configs that Quasar keeps applied on your servers
PluginData.Description:
Shared configs for the Sens Essentials Magnetar plugin, for admins running several servers.
Create named configs on the Sens Essentials page and choose which servers follow each one. Saving a config sends it to every server following it within seconds; offline servers get it when they connect. While a server follows a shared config, changes made to Sens Essentials on that server's Plugins page are undone. A config can also be started from the settings of a server you already set up.
The editor has most of the Torch plugin's tabs, plus Servers, with warnings for items that need attention. Choosing a config for a server replaces its settings once you confirm.
Needs the Sens Essentials Magnetar plugin on the servers. Includes a small companion Magnetar plugin (sensessentials.quasar) that Quasar adds to managed servers; restart servers that were running when this plugin was enabled. Cluster nodes are not managed, a cluster's plugins are configured through the cluster.
